summary: L-4 style lookout cabin on Burnt Fork Pinnacle, Lolo NF, about 1932; reported destroyed or removed in 1950; reached by a 3-mile trail; no remains described.

facts.status_note: Blog says destroyed in 1950; Kemnow says removed, no date; Kamstra and firelookout.org list it as gone

access.note: Forest Service trail from the Burnt Fork Trailhead to the summit; horses allowed; no structure described on the summit today

visit.trail_note: About three miles on Trail 418 from the Burnt Fork Trailhead to the summit; no potable water at the trailhead

events.note: L-4 style cabin built in or around 1932 per the 2011 blog; Kamstra gives 1932 for the L-4 cab

notes_for_editor: Fate: blog and Kamstra give 1950 destroyed/gone; Kemnow says removed with no date. Kemnow page gives Lolo NF and Missoula County. Staffing: no source found.
